_about: Live STANCES for real-time direct control (lanePARRY), read by StanceLayer.cs. A light modifier layer, off in steer mode (-steer: STStanceMods / steer.json stances own it there). Damage: FightBalance.HitMul multiplies a clean hit by the ATTACKER's dealtMul x the DEFENDER's takenMul; Trickster adds a per-hit seeded roll: pDealt chance of x dealtRollMul when he hits, pTaken chance of x takenRollMul when he is hit (owner: 25 % +30 % / 25 % +30 %). Defence: postureTakenMul scales the posture he takes on a block or a clean hit, blockCostMul the stamina a block costs him. feintCostMul scales the V feint cost (V3 Trickster: cheap feints). Numbers from steer.json stances (Aggressive 1.25 / 1.2, Defensive 0.8 / 0.75, Trickster 0.25 x1.3 / 0.25 x1.3). Not touched: block chip damage, the parry, speeds. Input: nextKeys / prevKeys (3 / 4: 1, 2, Z, X are the specials), mouse wheel (wheelCooldownS between steps), gamepad D-pad: padAxisX / padAxisY name Input Manager axes (Windows XInput D-pad = joystick axis 6 horizontal / 7 vertical; this project's Input Manager has no such axis yet, so add 'DPadX' = Joystick Axis 6 and 'DPadY' = Joystick Axis 7 in Project Settings > Input Manager; an undefined axis switches itself off with one log line) or padNextButtons / padPrevButtons (KeyCode JoystickButtonN, pads that report the D-pad as buttons). aiStance = the AI fighter's fixed stance. HUD: bottom-left label + a short centre toast on a switch.
